look_at_obj_in_light: ALWAYS load for ANY task that mentions a desklamp or floorlamp, or says look at / examine / inspect / see an object in light (e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp", "examine the book with the desklamp"). Take the object, go to the lamp, `use` it to turn it on. Not a put task.
pick_and_place: ALWAYS load for ANY task of the form "put/place/move a/some X in/on/to Y" with ONE object and none of the words clean/wash/hot/heat/cool/cold/lamp/two (e.g. "put a mug on the desk", "put some soap in the cabinet", "put a book on the bed", "put a pencil in the drawer"). Default skill for simple put tasks: find, take, put.
pick_clean_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "clean", "wash", or "rinse" with an object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet", "clean some mug and put it on the desk"). Take object to the sinkbasin, clean it, then place it.
pick_cool_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "cool", "cold", "chill", or "refrigerate" with an object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put a cool apple on the table", "cool some mug and put it in the cabinet"). Take object to the fridge, cool it, then place it.
pick_heat_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains "hot", "heat", "warm", or "cook" with an object to be put somewhere (e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop", "heat some egg and put it on the table"). Take object to the microwave, heat it, then place it.
pick_two_obj_and_place: ALWAYS load when the task says "two", "2", "both", or a plural object to put somewhere (e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa", "put two cds in the drawer", "find two soapbars and put them in the cabinet"). Even if it is a simple put, load this instead of pick_and_place. Place the first, then find and place a second, one at a time.
